The course will have a special provision on modality, pacing, pedagogy, assessment type, communication and feedback based on the national, regional, provincial, city, and institutional guidelines for the safety amidst disaster and pandemic. analyze agile software development methods;

Value the differences between functional and nonfunctional software requirements.

Weigh why requirements management is necessary and how it supports other requirements engineering activities.
